name: Kelvex TransitBound Ankle Monitor MK-2
description:
A mandatory court-issued ankle cuff in matte industrial grey polymer with a tamper-evident red indicator stripe. The housing is bulky by design — a visual deterrent as much as a tracking device. A small amber LED pulses every four seconds during normal operation; red indicates geofence proximity warning.

Issued by GLMZ Civil Compliance under Kelvex contract. The inner band is padded with cheap foam that degrades within months. Gene-compatible cutouts accommodate ankle-level geneware such as digitigrade leg modifications or scale ridges.
functionality: Continuous GPS tracking; geofence proximity alerts; tamper alarm triggers immediate compliance alert to Civil Enforcement; 90-day sealed battery; gene-compatible inner cutout geometry for non-standard ankle profiles.
what_it_says: The city knows exactly where you are, and it wants everyone else to know too.
story_hooks: A black-market firmware patch circulates on the Shelf that spoofs the monitor's GPS ping to a fixed location — sellers are disappearing.
The MK-2 batch has a hardware flaw: a specific sub-sonic frequency causes the tamper alarm to trigger falsely, getting wearers arrested without cause.
A Tier-4 exec is spotted wearing one voluntarily — either a kink, a bet, or a very public act of corporate sabotage.

physical_description.visual_profile: A chunky, utilitarian electronic cuff that dominates the ankle—impossible to hide or ignore. Sits prominently on the lower leg like an industrial manacle, broadcasting state surveillance to everyone in visual range. The design is deliberately punitive in its visibility.
physical_description.fit: Rigid and circumferential, snug against the ankle with minimal adjustment. Gene-compatible cutouts create an asymmetrical fit that adapts to augmented leg geometry. Sits slightly loose over standard human ankles but secure enough that removal requires intentional tampering—which triggers alarms.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte industrial grey polymer housing with stainless steel internal frame. Cheap foam padding inside degrades to crumbly residue within 6 months of wear. Polymer is impact-resistant but deliberately non-aesthetic.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, cold polymer exterior with faint manufacturing seams. The red indicator stripe is raised slightly, tactilely prominent. Interior foam padding is soft initially but becomes brittle and flaking. Metal contact points show wear and micro-scratching from movement.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominat matte industrial grey with a high-contrast red tamper-evident stripe running horizontally around the band. Small amber LED housing inset into the outer face. No branding visible—only a stamped serial number and Kelvex contract identifier.
physical_description.closures: Permanent electronic locking mechanism with mechanical tamper-seal. Cannot be removed without triggering alert. No user-accessible closures—security is the only function.
distinctive_features: Tamper-evident red indicator stripe that changes color if cuff is opened
Pulsing amber LED (4-second interval) during normal operation—switches to red during geofence proximity warning
Gene-compatible cutouts on inner band for digitigrade or scale-ridge leg modifications
Stamped serial number and GLMZ Civil Compliance contract identifier
Deliberately oversized profile designed as visual deterrent
Degrading foam padding visible as white crumbs in crevices after months of wear
Cold metal contact points that mark skin
Slight wireless antenna bump on outer face
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 / Sub-grade enforcement. This is not worn by choice—it signals legal restriction and surveillance subjugation. Wearing one marks you as monitored, likely criminal-adjacent or debt-imprisoned.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn exclusively by people under GLMZ civil compliance orders—court-mandated house arrest, debt servitude, parole, or regulatory restriction. It marks the wearer as subject to state/corporate surveillance, separated from free movement. Sight of one causes automatic social distance and assumed suspicion.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn continuously 24/7. Typically shows 3-6 months of degradation: foam padding flaking, micro-scratches and scuff marks on grey polymer, slight discoloration from sweat/skin oils around contact points, dust accumulated in gene-compatible cutouts. Red indicator stripe remains visible unless deliberately obscured. Amber LED may flicker as battery ages.
